name: SeSa S.p.A.
summary: SeSa S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, distributes value-added information technology (IT) software and technologies in Italy and internationally. It operates through five segments: Corporate and Digital Ecosystem, Software and System Integration (SSI), Business Services (BS), ICT Value Added Solutions (ICT VAS), and Digital Green VAS.
